briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies global AGI race as compute bottlenecks emerge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny. Funding surges past $14B this quarter while safety gaps widen in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with multimodal reasoning; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B; xAI deploys Grok-3; DeepSeek releases R2. Training runs now exceed 100k H100 equivalents.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. NIST issues new guidelines while DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips; Microsoft announces $50B data center expansion; NVIDIA Blackwell supply tightens through Q4; new sovereign AI clusters announced in UAE and Singapore.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any lab achieve AGI-level performance on SWE-Bench before 2027?
